description: North Central Province - Notify the Pawn Brokers' Statute No. 3 of 2017 of the North Central Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order under the Pawn Brokers Statute No. 3 of 2017, establishing registration fees, license fees, security deposits, interest rates, and identification requirements for pawn broking businesses. It represents subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
